Walls: 2-block tall walls on a 1-block high cobblestone foundation; place glowstone at outer face near corners with glass panes between glowstone blocks on each side.
Roof: layered stone slabs stepping outward from a center slab area — use slab rows offset by one block to create three visible tiers; some slabs placed as upside-down to form overhang.

rebuild_intent.summary: A small single-story symmetrical stone structure with a cross-shaped footprint and a stepped slab roof. Walls sit on a cobblestone base, with glowstone corner/side lights and glass window panes on each arm. The roof uses upside-down/regular stone slabs in layered steps.
